title: Markly – Image Watermarking MCP
description: Zero-friction image manipulation MCP: 10-second setup, no API key required. Commands like 'Add Copyright 2026 bottom-right, semi-transparent' or 'Watermark all images in /photos with my logo.png at 20%'. Single npx command to integrate. Handles batch watermarking across directories.
notes: Novel capability — no equivalent in current stack. Document Generation section covers PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX but not image manipulation. Could be useful for blog asset management (Ashita Orbis) and game asset pipeline. Zero dependency model (no API key) is a positive signal. Star count and GitHub URL unconfirmed — verify before integrating.
